name: Gretex Corporate Services Ltd
title: Gretex Corporate Services Ltd - 543324 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue fell 5% YoY to INR75.6 cr and EBITDA margin collapsed to 12.7% as only one IPO listed; prior guidance of 3-4 Q2 listings missed, with pipeline of 4 DRHP-stage approvals.

triggers.quote: Our initial target is to build monthly advisory retainers in the range of INR10 lakhs to INR50 lakhs, or INR 1 crore, as these relationships mature.

summary.headline: Gretex Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue fell 5% YoY to INR75.6 crore and EBITDA margin dropped to 12.70%, as only one listing was completed.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue from operations was INR75.60 crore, down 5% YoY from INR79.60 crore but up 101.6% QoQ. EBITDA fell to INR9.6 crore from INR31.7 crore, with margin at 12.70% versus 39.82%, and PAT was INR7.1 crore versus INR12.8 crore. For H1 FY27, revenue rose 11.4% to INR113.1 crore and PAT rose 43.2% to INR19.9 crore, helped by other income of INR1.5 crore against negative INR11.5 crore a year earlier. Management attributed the weak quarter mainly to the low number of mainboard and SME listings, with only one listing (Vama Wovenfab) completed during the period.

segments.name: Merchant banking (IPO management)
segments.commentary: Core SME IPO franchise; in H1 FY27 four mandates moved to DRHP stage (Sky Alloys and Power, Tenty on mainboard; Abacus Lifestyle Brands and Oremet Alloys on NSE Emerge). Vama Wovenfab listed on BSE SME on September 22, 2026; underwriting mandate won from Army Infotech; preferential issue mandate for Taurian MPS.

segments.name: Alternative investments
segments.commentary: First close of Celestial Chakra Momentum Fund at INR25 crore, jointly sponsored by Gretex Corporate Services and Gretex Share Broking via Bahutex Ventures; company aims to become sponsor of a Category II AIF platform.

segments.name: Broking (Gretex Share Broking Ltd)
segments.commentary: Opened new branch in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, to expand institutional broking, retail broking and market-making. No broking revenue figures were disclosed.

guidance_outlook: Management expects all four mandates in the approval pipeline to list, possibly in Q3 or Q4 FY27 (quarter not firmly committed).
Targets monthly post-listing advisory retainers of INR10 lakh to INR50 lakh (up to INR1 crore) as relationships mature.
Strategy: keep SME IPO management as core, selectively expand into mainboard mandates, and build recurring advisory and investment-led revenue streams.
capex_capacity: The call gave no capex figures, capacity or utilisation data, and no capex plans or commissioning timelines.
Broking subsidiary Gretex Share Broking opened a new branch in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, to expand institutional broking, retail broking and market-making; no cost or revenue figures were disclosed.

Celestial Chakra Momentum Fund had a first close of INR25 crore, jointly sponsored by Gretex Corporate Services and Gretex Share Broking via Bahutex Ventures; no further fund close timeline or commitment size was given.
Management aims to become sponsor of a Category II AIF platform, but gave no timeline or capital commitment for it.
demand_pricing: Mainboard IPO fundraising in H1 FY27 was about INR84,400 crore, up around 30% YoY, with 71 companies listing versus 55 in H1 FY26.
SME IPO listings fell to 137 from 156 YoY, and SME IPO fundraising fell about 11% to INR6,012 crore.
Management says investors are becoming more selective on fundamentals and valuation, with subscription levels normalising.
Revenue decline in Q2 was attributed to few listings, not to margin pressure; management said the margin fall follows directly from lower turnover.

qa_highlights.question: Chat question: what is the reason for the significant decline in margins?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there was no margin decline as such, only a fall in top line because only one listing was done this quarter versus more in the prior-year period; lower turnover drove the lower margin.

qa_highlights.question: Dipesh Kanoria asked about the kind of transactions in the pipeline.
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there are 4 approvals in hand that are supposed to list, and it hopes all listings will be done this quarter or next.

risks_watch: Revenue depends on listing timing; only one listing in Q2 and the four approved issues have not yet listed.
SME IPO market is moderating (fundraising down about 11% YoY) and investors are more selective on valuation.
Q2 EBITDA margin of 12.70% versus 39.82% a year ago; H1 profit boost partly came from other income swing of about INR13 crore, which is not operating.
Mainboard execution is still limited to a few mandates; the shift to recurring advisory and AIF income is at an early stage with no revenue quantified.
summary.management_tone: Confident on pipeline and strategy, but defensive on the Q2 decline; management framed the margin fall as a timing issue from fewer listings and gave no firm timeline for the pending approvals.
key_quotes: That is the only reason we had a lower turnover, and that is the reason the margin is lower.
Today, we have 4 approvals in our hand which are supposed to be listed. So, we hope that maybe this quarter or the next quarter, all the listings will be done.

growth.why: Q2 revenue fell 5% YoY to INR75.6 cr and EBITDA dropped to INR9.6 cr on only one listing; management hopes four approved IPOs list in Q3 or Q4 FY27 (not firmly committed), with no capacity additions or revenue guidance given.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 12.70% from 39.82% on revenue of INR75.6 crore, and management tied the drop to lower listing-driven turnover rather than cost actions or pricing, so recovery depends on listing volume.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: No plant, line or fund-capacity timelines were given; the Ahmedabad broking branch opened but had no cost or revenue figures disclosed.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Four approved issues (Sky Alloys and Power, Tenty, Abacus Lifestyle Brands, Oremet Alloys) could list in Q3 or Q4 FY27, but management gave no firm date, and SME IPO listings fell to 137 from 156 YoY.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: No capex figures, utilisation data or capex plans were discussed; the company is asset-light merchant banking.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management gave no numeric guidance, Q2 revenue fell 5% YoY to INR75.6 crore, and listing timing is uncertain with SME fundraising down about 11% YoY.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Only one listing completed in Q2 against four approvals in hand, and if the pending issues slip beyond Q4 FY27 revenue would stay weak; H1 PAT was lifted by about INR13 crore of other income swing that is not operating.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Advisory retainers of INR10-50 lakh per month and the Category II AIF platform were targeted, but no revenue was quantified and no launch date was given.

rows.label: Category II AIF sponsorship and Celestial Chakra fund
rows.why: First close of INR25 crore on Celestial Chakra Momentum Fund, with aim to become Category II AIF sponsor, but no further close timeline or commitment size was given.

rows.label: Mainboard mandates and recurring advisory
rows.why: Sky Alloys and Power and Tenty moved to DRHP on mainboard, and mainboard IPO fundraising rose about 30% YoY to INR84,400 crore in H1 FY27, but execution is limited to a few mandates.

rows.label: Post-listing advisory retainer ramp
rows.why: Management targets monthly retainers of INR10-50 lakh (up to INR1 crore) per mandate, but no current revenue is quantified.

tone.note: Management was confident on the four-issue pipeline and mainboard/AIF strategy but defensive on the Q2 revenue and margin fall, which it blamed on only one listing; analysts pressed on the margin decline and the timing of pending approvals.
